segments.an5.250:1.3: Yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti, so tathārūpaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno hoti yathārūpāya āpattiyā saṅgho ukkhipati.
segments.an5.250:1.5: ‘yo kho myāyaṃ puggalo piyo manāpo so saṅghena ukkhitto’ti.
segments.an5.250:1.7: Bhikkhūsu appasādabahulo samāno aññe bhikkhū na bhajati.
segments.an5.250:1.8: Aññe bhikkhū abhajanto saddhammaṃ na suṇāti.
segments.an5.250:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti, so tathārūpaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno hoti yathārūpāya āpattiyā saṅgho ante nisīdāpeti.
segments.an5.250:2.3: ‘yo kho myāyaṃ puggalo piyo manāpo so saṅghena ante nisīdāpito’ti.
segments.an5.250:2.5: Bhikkhūsu appasādabahulo samāno aññe bhikkhū na bhajati.
segments.an5.250:2.6: Aññe bhikkhū abhajanto saddhammaṃ na suṇāti.
segments.an5.250:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti, so disāpakkanto hoti … pe … so vibbhanto hoti … pe … so kālaṅkato hoti.
segments.an5.250:3.3: ‘yo kho myāyaṃ puggalo piyo manāpo so kālaṅkato’ti.
segments.an5.250:3.5: Aññe bhikkhū abhajanto saddhammaṃ na suṇāti.
segments.an5.250:3.8: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā puggalappasāde”ti.
